purpose: Original conceptual editorial covers for five scientific illustration guides; not experimental evidence.

covers.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: wide editorial cover for a practical guide to AI scientific figure generation. Create a refined scientific illustration on a warm white background, landscape 3:2 composition. A slim sheet of research notes at left transforms through a subtle arrow into a large beautifully composed cellular schematic at right: cell membrane, nucleus, a few colored protein shapes, restrained crisp connectors. Delicate navy outlines with teal, apricot and lavender fills. Flat editorial scientific illustration with subtle tactile depth, exceptionally tidy composition and generous whitespace. No charts, no measurement data, no anatomical or clinical claims. No interface, no logos, no text, no letters, no watermark. This is a conceptual illustration, not experimental evidence.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: wide editorial cover for a graphical abstract writing guide. Landscape 3:2 image on warm white. Deliberate clean flow with just two simple directional arrows. Flat refined scientific editorial illustration with navy linework, muted teal, apricot and lilac, subtle soft shadows, plenty of white space. Spacious, balanced, professional journal editorial aesthetic. No text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no decorative DNA.
